author: Dunk
description:
11th Edition has finally landed, and after a handful of games, I’ve started to form some early impressions. As ever with a new edition of Warhammer 40k, there’s excitement, confusion, and the usual “wait… is that how it works now?” moments. Here’s how things are feeling so far.

The post 11th Edition first impressions: the good, the confusing, and the slow appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: 11th Edition first impressions: the good, the confusing, and the slow
